passage: 校园志愿活动 has become an important topic among college students. A student group recently ran an eight-week pilot project involving 120 participants. The project showed that small, regular actions were more effective than a single large event. Participants said clear goals and timely feedback helped them continue, although lack of time remained the most common difficulty. In response, the organizers shortened the weekly tasks and provided practical guidance. In the final survey, three quarters of the participants said they intended to continue, so the organizers plan to invite more students next term.
